Historical full-card image of [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (Remastered 2006)|Careful Planning]], matching the [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
